<!-- pr-reviewer: 5fef611a75c274901dc5cc2a350456179e27df7b -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One requested change (item 1 below); the rest is notes.

main does not build (#844); built and tested on PR + main + the pending #844 fix (PR #848, 4a5c9dd4ca304735f31ce9f936c4e66cecda0c26). The trial merge with origin/main (4865500d) is textually clean. Without the #844 fix, the only failures were the seven E0308/E0609 errors in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs`, which are not a finding against this PR.

**What looks good**
- The light theme gets a light ground from a theme token (`Tokens::viewport`, theme.rs:135 dark, :177 light), and the render clear colour reads it (viewport.rs:800, `View3D::render_with`). Dark keeps its value (0x171A1F, which is within 0.001 of the old 0.09/0.10/0.12 clear).
- Overlay inks are chosen through `ground_ink::overlay_ink` and the light ground is detected by luma, so the dark set stays the old consts.
- Contrast is pinned by tests, not just claimed: `every_overlay_ink_clears_3_to_1_on_the_light_viewport`, `the_light_palette_move_inks_clear_3_to_1`, `the_light_wireframe_and_axis_inks_clear_3_to_1`, `the_light_cube_sits_a_step_under_the_viewport_with_darker_edges`, plus dark-keeps-house-inks tests.
- No `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/*.png` changes in the PR's file list.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added in non-test code (grep of added lines).
- Theme files: `viewport` is an optional key through `c(names::VIEWPORT, viewport)` in theme_files.rs, so an older theme file without it falls back to the built-in token (no error).
- Layering: ui only; the theme choice path is unchanged (no new state).
- Changelog, `Fixes #698` and a decision file are present.

**Local results (merged tree: PR + main + #844 fix)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui) | 492 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `viewport_ground_tests` + `debug_info_tests` (within the above) | 14 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Finished, no warnings |

Not run: the snapshot lane (release-only), `--ignored` lanes, other crates' suites. The PR touches only camcraft-ui, and motion was built only because of the #844 fix.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/colorvision.rs:231-232` and `:240` (`palette_for`): on a light ground only `ColorVision::Off` gets a light palette. Protan/Deutan (`RED_GREEN`) and Tritan (`TRITAN`) keep their dark-tuned inks on the light viewport, and no test checks their contrast there. #698's own comment says the colour-vision palettes need the same 3:1 check. Either add the light sets and pin them with the same contrast test, or state the gap in the PR body and the decision file as an open item for a follow-up issue. A colour-vision user on a light theme must not get unreadable overlays silently.

**Notes (not blocking)**
2. `theme.rs:271-272`: `widgets.open.weak_bg_fill = ink_alt` and `fg_stroke = text` are set for both columns, not only light. The PR body says dark is unchanged; please confirm this does not move the dark look (the structural tests may not cover it). Otherwise guard it with `light_ground(ink)` like the hover fill at :254.
3. `window_chrome.rs` (new, 74 lines) replaces the Debug info window's title bar with a custom collapse and close row. That is a behaviour change beyond the viewport ground. It is covered only by one test (`the_title_row_folds_...`). It reads as a reasonable light-theme fix, but say in the PR body why it is in this PR.
4. `ground_ink.rs` puts the light-set literals in one module, which is fine, but they are not theme tokens. A later theme-file editor cannot change them. Consider it a follow-up, not a blocker.
5. Size: `viewport.rs` goes 1472 to 1484 lines and `shell.rs` stays at 1676 (both over 400 before this PR; not grown much). `ground_ink.rs` at 177 lines is a good split. Non-blocking.
6. Overlap: #841/#847 split `shell.rs` and #645 touches viewport labels; this PR edits the viewport_panel overlay lines in shell.rs (around :1317-1400) and `viewport.rs`. Not checked against those branches.
7. The light look (palette, cube, title row) is a visual call. It needs the maintainer's eye, and the snapshot PNGs will need the refresh at the cut.
8. Dark clear colour changes from f32 0.09/0.10/0.12 to 0x17/0x1A/0x1F (about 0.0902/0.1020/0.1216). This is below one 8-bit step; no action needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6177922d83c55af7e85118e64fee5f62703f7152 -->
**Requested change resolved, but the PR now conflicts with main. Needs a merge of main before merge.**

Delta reviewed: `5fef611a..6177922d` (one commit, 5 files, `crates/ui` plus `docs/decisions/698-light-viewport.md`). No snapshot PNG is touched.

### The requested change (colorvision.rs `palette_for`)
- Resolved. `palette_for` now sends Protan/Deutan to `RED_GREEN_LIGHT_GROUND` and Tritan to `TRITAN_LIGHT_GROUND` on a light ground (`colorvision.rs:236-238`). Dark stays `palette(mode)`.
- New test `the_light_colour_vision_sets_pass_the_cvd_gate_and_clear_3_to_1` (`viewport_ground_tests.rs`) checks, for each of Protan, Deutan and Tritan on the light set: every `must_distinguish` pair against `MIN_DE00` through `cvd::seen_apart` with that mode, and every line ink (feed, rapid, plunge, bound include/exclude/open) against the same `GRAPHIC` 3.0 bar as the default mode. That is the requested test, not a "palette exists" check.
- The colours are distinguishable from each other under the simulation gate, not only from the ground.

### Other notes from the first review
- `theme.rs`: the `widgets.open` fill and text now apply only on the light theme (taken). The dark title bar keeps egui's own open fill, pinned by `the_dark_title_bar_keeps_eguis_own_open_fill`.
- Not addressed (non-blocking): `window_chrome.rs` still reaches past the viewport ground, and the new light literals in `ground_ink.rs` are still outside the theme tokens.
- The PR body was updated and describes the colour-vision work (line 13 and the test list). Good.

### Local results
- Trial merge with `origin/main` (2046357b) conflicts in one file: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (this branch has `10`, main has `12`). Per the review rules, the verdict is `conflicts` and I did not build. The only conflicting file is the process version number; the fix is a `git merge origin/main` on the branch, taking main's `12`, plus a PROCESS_VERSION bump if the branch changes process files (it does not).
- Because I did not build, the new tests were not run by this review. Please rely on your own `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` run after the merge.
- The light look still needs the maintainer's eye, and the snapshot goldens are refreshed at the cut.

### Requested before merge
1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch, keep main's `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` value, push (plain push). No other change is needed for this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b358e904b5589b56ddebd544a0ad371147160498 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This completes the earlier review of this head (`5fef611a..6177922d`). That review labelled the PR `conflicts` because its local trial merge with main conflicted in `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The `conflicts` verdict was wrong for GitHub: the PR reports MERGEABLE / CLEAN. The build and tests were not run then; they have been run now.

**Head note:** the branch has since moved to `b358e904`, a merge of an older upstream main (`72ab8fdb`, an ancestor of current main) into the branch. Its only change of its own is `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, set to `12`. The 16 files this PR changes are the same as at `6177922d`, so the build below covers `b358e904` too.

### Why local git and GitHub disagree on `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`
- At `6177922d` the bytes were: PR head `10\n` (LF), main `12\r\n` (CRLF, and not the same as the value on the branch), and the merge base `9\n`. `git merge-base --all` returns two bases here (criss-cross history: `e2d655e` and `0d72518f`). The recursive merge builds a virtual base from them, and that virtual base carries conflict markers in this file, so local git reports a content conflict. GitHub merges against the real base and sees a clean result.
- At `b358e904` the file is `12\n` (LF). It is the same value as main; only the line ending differs from main's CRLF.
- Nothing else conflicts. Only this one file.

### What was built and run
Trial merge with `origin/main` (2046357b), `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` resolved to main's `12`, local only and never pushed. Built in a review-only target dir.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 495 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0, no warnings |

Targeted tests, all `ok`:
- `viewport_ground_tests::the_light_colour_vision_sets_pass_the_cvd_gate_and_clear_3_to_1` (the requested change)
- `viewport_ground_tests::every_mode_wears_its_light_set_on_a_light_ground`
- `viewport_ground_tests::the_dark_title_bar_keeps_eguis_own_open_fill`
- `viewport_ground_tests::every_overlay_ink_clears_3_to_1_on_the_light_viewport`
- `viewport_ground_tests::the_light_palette_move_inks_clear_3_to_1`
- `viewport_ground_tests::the_light_wireframe_and_axis_inks_clear_3_to_1`
- `viewport_ground_tests::the_light_viewport_is_light_and_the_dark_one_stays_dark`
- the rest of `viewport_ground_tests`, `debug_info_tests` (including `the_title_row_folds_the_window_and_its_close_button_closes_it`), `theme_door::the_theme_door_carries_the_colour_vision_modes`, `path_lines` and `law_tests::path_tests` colour-vision tests

Snapshot PNGs are not run (`#[ignore]`d, release lane). No `--ignored` lanes were run.

### Requested change: resolved
Protan/Deutan and Tritan now get light-ground palettes (`RED_GREEN_LIGHT_GROUND`, `TRITAN_LIGHT_GROUND`, `colorvision.rs:236-238`). The new test passes, so the colour-vision pairs clear the CVD gate and every line ink clears 3:1 on the light ground.

### Still open, non-blocking (from the earlier review)
1. `window_chrome.rs` reaches beyond the viewport ground (the Debug info title row). It is covered by one test and explained in the PR body.
2. The light literals in `ground_ink.rs` are not theme tokens. Follow-up, as the author's decision file records (item 7).
3. The light look (palette, cube, title row) needs the maintainer's eye. The snapshot goldens are refreshed at the cut, not in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
